summary: Read a single line of tokens split by commas. Each token is either an integer or a hash mark, and a hash mark means a child is absent. Decide whether the line can be the preorder record of some binary tree: when a node is visited, its token comes first, then the whole left side, then the whole right side. Two commas never sit next to each other. Write true or false.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is one token of text without spaces.
